'''Ardees Beverage Company''' was a beverage manufacturing and distributing corporation during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were most famous for their [[Ardees/Legends|ardees]] alcoholic beverage, to which they paid 3.1 billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to [[Grav-ball/Legends|grav-ball]] star [[Deme Tryshyn]] to be a spokesbeing for. It also manufactured [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]].

It had a presence on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
